deepseek-v4-flash.description: NeuroLink default. On https://www.lemonfox.ai/apis/chat (retrieved 2026-09-29) the model parameter reads "Specify the model ID to be used. Default: deepseek-v4-flash. Also supported: mimo-v2.5-pro.", the introduction says "We support state-of-the-art open-source AI models, including DeepSeek V4 Flash (default) and MiMo V2.5 Pro.", and the model table row reads "DeepSeek V4 Flash is our default model — fast, cost-effective, and suitable for most tasks. Supports a 1M token context window." with "Price / 1M tokens" $0.50. contextWindow 1000000 is NeuroLink's decimal reading of "1M". The page's JavaScript, Python and Curl examples name this id.

mimo-v2.5-pro.description: NeuroLink fallback. On https://www.lemonfox.ai/apis/chat (retrieved 2026-09-29) the model parameter reads "Specify the model ID to be used. Default: deepseek-v4-flash. Also supported: mimo-v2.5-pro.", the introduction names "MiMo V2.5 Pro", and the model table row reads "MiMo V2.5 Pro is a powerful model from Xiaomi, recommended for complex reasoning and coding tasks." with "Price / 1M tokens" $1.25. No contextWindow is set.

errorRules.message: Lemonfox AI answered HTTP 401 (a request with no key gets: "You didn't provide an API key."). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Keys: https://lemonfox.ai/apis/keys

instructions: 1. Visit: https://lemonfox.ai/signup (the "Get started" and "Start Your Free Trial" links on https://www.lemonfox.ai/apis/chat both point to /signup); sign-up was not attempted while building this entry

2. Create an API key at https://lemonfox.ai/apis/keys — https://www.lemonfox.ai/apis/chat links "create an API key" to that page, and the API's 401 reply says "You can obtain an API key from https://lemonfox.ai/apis/keys."

3. Billing as the vendor states it: https://www.lemonfox.ai/ shows "Try our APIs for 1 month for free."; https://www.lemonfox.ai/apis/chat shows "First month for free!" and lists "Price / 1M tokens" of $0.50 for deepseek-v4-flash and $1.25 for mimo-v2.5-pro; https://www.lemonfox.ai/terms says Lemon Fox GmbH uses Paddle as its Merchant of Record and offers "subscription-based pricing and usage-based pricing"
setup.description: Docs-verified only: the vendor's GET https://api.lemonfox.ai/v1/models needs a key (it answers HTTP 401 without one), so the two model ids come from https://www.lemonfox.ai/apis/chat (retrieved 2026-09-29) and the roster has not been checked; the entry is not yet live-verified. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.lemonfox.ai/v1: the page says "Our OpenAI-compatible API takes a list of messages as input and provides an AI-generated (assistant) message as output.", its JavaScript and Python examples pass baseURL/base_url "https://api.lemonfox.ai/v1" to the OpenAI client, its API Parameters section shows POST https://api.lemonfox.ai/v1/chat/completions, and its Curl example sends the header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Unauthenticated GETs made 2026-09-29: /models, /chat/completions and the base URL /v1 each answered HTTP 401 with the JSON body {"status":401,"error":{"message":"You didn't provide an API key. You need to provide your API key in an Authorization header using Bearer auth (i.e. Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY). You can obtain an API key from https://lemonfox.ai/apis/keys.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":null,"code":null}}. No POST request was sent. errorRules holds one rule, for status 401. The page's model table lists deepseek-v4-flash and mimo-v2.5-pro; a second table under the heading "Deprecated models" lists llama-8b-chat and llama-70b-chat, each description starting "Deprecated.", and those two ids are not in this catalog. models.defaultContextWindow (32768) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4096) are placeholders the vendor does not publish, for model ids outside models.catalog; the page's max_tokens parameter reads "integer, optional, default: infinity". deepseek-v4-flash's contextWindow (1000000) is NeuroLink's decimal reading of "Supports a 1M token context window."; mimo-v2.5-pro has no contextWindow set. pricingPerMTok is unset on both models: the model table has one column, "Price / 1M tokens" ($0.50 and $1.25), and the catalog field takes separate input and output figures. Each model's vision field holds false, a placeholder for a boolean the catalog schema requires; it is not a vendor statement. Each model's status field holds production, a value the catalog schema requires; the page lists these two models in its main table. capabilities.text is true because the page's examples send a messages array and read choices[0].message.content. capabilities.streaming is true because the page's stream parameter reads "incremental message updates are transmitted as server-sent events with data-only messages." capabilities.tools, toolsWithStreaming, structuredOutput, structuredOutputWithTools, embeddings and thinking are false, meaning not declared by this entry: the page's API Parameters section lists messages, model, max_tokens, stop, stream, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, temperature and top_p, and no request exercising any capability was sent. billingPolicy holds free-with-card, the growth queue's classification, because the catalog schema has no unknown value and takes one of free-tier, free-with-card and no-free-tier; it is not a vendor statement of signup terms, and the vendor's own wording is in setup.instructions step 3 and evidence.billingProbe. apiKeyFormat is null so NeuroLink's key-format check is not applied.
